name: CI Pipelines
description: GitHub Actions workflow definitions automating builds, instruction-package packaging, and verification gates.

name: Integration & Host Contracts
description: Contracts binding GWC to external hosts and systems — E2E replayable pilot, GitHub G5/G6 Jira projection, task-me and UA host modes, BMAD procedure adapter, DW super-app integration topology — plus the g2 skill library.

name: Runtime Node Catalog
description: The node-architect catalog under core/node-architect/: versioned runtime node definitions (failure recovery, checkpoints, scenarios), durable runtime store/kernel contracts, and canonical registries for nodes, decision rules, profiles, runtime graphs, and scenarios.

name: Runbooks
description: Operational runbooks and capability guidance for executing gate procedures, e.g., the GATE_G0_G1 operational runbook and notification capability guidance.

name: Governance Core Contracts
description: Foundational markdown contracts and policies at the core/ root governing gate lifecycle (G0_CONTEXT–G6_PRODUCTION_DATA), approval envelopes, human bypass, interrupt flow, agent behavior semantics, CI verification, and standing automation policy; plus top-level governance/ policy registries (base-drift-policy, instruction-source-registry).

name: Agent Instruction Routing
description: Per-host agent instructions and capability manifests under agents/ plus the repository-level AGENTS.md entry point that routes agents to project profiles.

name: Project Profiles & Extensions
description: Per-project profiles, instructions, extensions, and package manifests under projects/ (gwc, ds-mcp) defining how consumer projects adopt GWC.

name: Schemas
description: JSON Schema contracts validating gate decisions and evidence (g01, g1, g5, approval-expiry recovery, base drift, CI observation), durable runtime events/checkpoints/graphs, node-architect taxonomy, and integration surfaces (BMAD, e2e-pilot, Jira/GitHub projection); includes g1 preflight templates.

name: Tooling & Scripts
description: Python tooling implementing durable runtime checkpoint handling, project runtime knowledge-graph projection, and node-catalog/taxonomy validators.

name: Task Records & Evidence
description: Per-task work records under .gwc/tasks/: SCRUM ticket folders containing validator outputs, evidence captures, provenance maps, and decision records generated during gate execution.

name: Automation Run Logs
description: Execution run artifacts from .task-me/runs/: timestamped fastlane/task-me runs with plans, logs, and step traces from automated delivery sessions.

name: Kiro Specs & Planning
description: Spec-driven development documents under .kiro/specs/ — requirements/design/tasks triples for each GWC phase and SCRUM initiative.

name: Release Changelogs
description: Dated changelog fragments under releases/changelog.d plus the aggregated changelog documenting each release's contract, registry, and process changes.

name: Integration Examples
description: Worked examples under examples/integrations/ demonstrating host-mode wiring (task-me, ua), cross-phase flows, e2e-pilot usage, and GitHub G5/G6 Jira projection setups.

name: Documentation & Repository Metadata
description: Human-facing docs (authority matrix, drift policy, backward-compiler/scenario-routing contract docs) alongside repository metadata: UA knowledge-graph artifacts, distribution package/config, MCP server configs, tree/hash/bundle reports, README, and editor-agent working files (.kilo plans, task-architect config).
